Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
I think an important question would be: what material do you want them to be? Ive noticed plenty of people who sell their token-like items via etsy.com. I for example bought custom-made acrylic tokens to android netrunner that way. Its like a place where individuals can sell their craftsmanship collectively. Maybe you could find someone with whom to discuss the design there.

Example: www.etsy.com/market/game_tokens
